recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片細胞量偏高，可見數個顏色較淡、界線不清的間質性淋巴組織球結節，散布在骨小樑之間，其餘骨髓仍有正常三系造血（含巨核細胞）；低倍只能提示「淋巴組織球性病灶」，需要高倍與免疫染色才能定性。
features: Hypercellular marrow for age with multiple ill-defined interstitial nodules
Nodules are paler than surrounding marrow, suggestive of histiocyte-rich composition
Nodules are non-paratrabecular, located between bony trabeculae
Intervening marrow shows trilineage hematopoiesis with megakaryocytes
Preserved bony trabeculae without obvious fibrosis at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power H&E section of a bone marrow core biopsy shows a cellular marrow containing multiple ill-defined, pale interstitial lymphohistiocytic nodules that are not paratrabecular. The intervening marrow shows trilineage hematopoiesis with megakaryocytes, and bony trabeculae are unremarkable. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification. Such lymphohistiocytic nodules warrant high-power evaluation and immunohistochemistry; in this case they represent involvement by T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Benign aggregates are small, few, well-circumscribed, and non-paratrabecular without histiocyte-rich pale nodules or atypical large cells.
Granulomas are compact epithelioid clusters, may contain giant cells or necrosis, and lack large atypical B cells on IHC.
FL typically forms paratrabecular aggregates of small cleaved cells rather than interstitial histiocyte-rich nodules.
Mast cell lesions are paratrabecular or perivascular spindle-cell aggregates with eosinophils and are tryptase/CD117/CD25 positive.
